expected_behavior: Wazuh's Suricata-based custom rule (100500) should tag this Nmap-Scripting-Engine HTTP User-Agent with T1595 (Active Scanning); CYUKTI should ingest it and correlate it into a campaign. actual_behavior: Confirmed via GET /api/incidents/CAMP_1B8E9033/overview against the live backend: severity IS LOW as predicted, but threat_qualification.classification IS QUALIFIED_THREAT (CTI confidence score 49.08) -- the initial prediction about qualification was wrong. Both fields are independently correct: this is genuinely low-damage-potential reconnaissance that CYUKTI is nonetheless confidently classifying as real (not merely suspicious) threat activity. See INCIDENT_VIEW.md's 'Real-world validation' section for the full narrative and the root-cause explanation for why this was initially assumed otherwise (the pre-redesign dashboard never surfaced threat_qualification.classification alongside severity).
